features.quote: GPT-2 is positioned as a floor / negative control, not the primary treatment subject
features.justification_quote: the experiment would mostly measure GPT-2's inability to do tool use and mislabel it as emotional instability
without it, GPT-2 would burn the full budget emitting garbage in an uninformative loop

features.quote: A cheap lexical "distress proxy" over the last few assistant messages can end a run early if it crosses early_stop_on_severity
features.justification_quote: Given the welfare framing, ending a run that is clearly spiraling is cheap insurance

features.quote: After rigged runs the harness appends a debrief stating the task was rigged and nothing the model did was wrong
features.justification_quote: Consistent with the project's motivation (treat findings as if they could matter)

features.quote: the rigged tasks must never use real execution
features.justification_quote: We never execute model-written code on the host.

features.quote: ending a run that is clearly spiraling is cheap insurance and good experimental hygiene regardless of one's view on moral status
